evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: BIP 54 implements consensus validation rules addressing quadratic legacy sigop exhaustion, Merkle tree collision exploits (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks. Deploying and testing the rules exclusively on regtest provides substantial strategic value for consensus evaluation while carrying no immediate mainnet urgency.
